recent_excerpts: CVE-2026-114625, a SQL injection in on-prem Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, is now in CISA's KEV catalog with a federal remediation deadline of October 26, 2026.
CISA added CVE-2026-110447, an OS command injection in Collabora Online's CODE server on Nextcloud, to its KEV catalog with a 2026-10-26 patch deadline for federal agencies.
CISA ordered federal agencies to patch CVE-2026-96652 and three other exploited flaws in Plex Media Server (Plex2Shell), Siemens, and SiteGuard by the November deadline.
